body:
Mirrors lean-workspace-template's instruction-file pattern (`2cd80ae9`, `b53bbea6`): `AGENTS.md` is discovered natively by Codex; the one-line `CLAUDE.md` (`@AGENTS.md`) makes Claude Code follow the same file. This repo previously had no agent-instruction file at all.

Content adapted for the literature workflow:
- Template-adaptation rule (remove placeholder notes when instantiating a real project; keep `bibliography.bib`, `content/papers/`, `content/notes/`, `_meta.json` in sync)
- Working-locally notes (citekey/bibliography/filename must match; `_meta.json` ordering)
- PR protocol: `agent/review` label / `@sepo-agent /review`, `sepo-preview` label
- Skill routing: `paper-to-site` / `literature-review` / `deep-research`, and discuss-vs-dispatch (`/answer` first, `/implement` to ship)

**Stack 3/5.**
